description: The product is specified and sold as a 'universal web-research product' (spec line 6) that returns research for 'a buyer's query' on 'ANY fresh install', honoring the operating principle 'build for ALL human-funded AI.' The implementation uses HN Algolia with tags=story, which only indexes Hacker News submissions. This is a tech/startup-news corpus, NOT the open web. Any non-tech query (e.g. 'best sourdough recipe', 'symptoms of vitamin D deficiency', 'tax filing deadline France') will return 0 hits, hitting line 31 'no search results' and exiting 1. The product therefore fails R1's '>=1 real external result URL' for the large majority of general queries and is not universal. The code comment on line 9 ('tech-relevant — the x402 buyer audience') silently narrows scope away from the spec without amending it.
